videos.title: Cem Karsan Explains Why All That News Didn’t Move the Market
videos.description:
Cem Karsan calls this the most extreme example yet of flows overpowering macro. Lay out everything that happened over two weeks and almost nobody would believe the index is sitting roughly 2% from its all-time high. His explanation is mechanical: options markets have grown so large they're no longer the tail wagging the dog, they are the dog, and the skew sitting in them has become the biggest carry trade in the world. Every day without a big move, dealers buy deltas and sell vol.
